original_combined.format: sector and team_doc_id plus unchanged original_record

development_and_evaluation: pharma_as02 preserves the actual 100/100 split used in recorded API experiments. Each condition uses 50 as specified in run manifests. No invented team-wide train/test split.
sector_label_sets: The three as01_labeled_records files contain the actual reference-label subsets, 25 Pharma, 28 Finance, 25 Tech. They are not a common benchmark.
label_warning: Finance label_provenance explicitly states model pre-annotation with independent human review not confirmed. Tech has no per-row provenance field. Pharma annotation_summary records human review.
fine_tuning: None performed. Chatlogs contain inference/evaluation calls to instruction-tuned models, not newly fine-tuned weights.
